findings.write.why: the finding registry's rows of tohum/26h MF8 (fingerprint, proposal to finding rows, gate decisions to fixed and unresolved rows) as functions over the two files' bytes, run by test 12 (tests/test_findings_write.py) only; no job hands it an adapter proposal, and the write to brain/state with the root over both files is not built (seed-086), so MF8 is not in done_mf

gate.allowlist.why: P1 MF9's rules (tohum/26h, test 55): the allowlist read from accept rows, the gate's decision over a package's organ_ids and the accept rows' writer, run by test 55 (tests/test_allowlist.py) only; nothing in the loop calls it until the pages give where a run-time package's organ_ids is read, which organs a cycle enters and when, and a row's evidence run ids (seed-087), so MF9 is not in done_mf

ledger.founder.why: the founder ledger's rules and its append command, run by a session and by test 14 (tests/test_founder_ledger.py); the loop never writes founder rows

profile.docker.why: what a Dockerfile copies from its build context and the build contexts compose files name, read by status.depmap (a session tool) only; run by tests 42 and 47 (tests/test_depmap.py, tests/test_profile_docker.py)

profile.fit.why: a session composes each unit candidate's recipe from its own npm scripts and judges it with unit_verify.check_recipe; its --units output is targets/<target>/units.json, which loop.cek reads; run by a session and by test 47 (tests/test_profile_fit.py)

profile.ghactions.why: the image builds (context, Dockerfile) GitHub Actions steps of docker/build-push-action declare, matrices and expressions over matrix evaluated statically, read by status.depmap (a session tool) only; run by tests 42 and 47 (tests/test_depmap.py, tests/test_profile_ghactions.py)

profile.jsimports.why: the one reader of a JS/TS tree's references (walk, import specifiers, tsconfig extends and path aliases, a bare specifier's package), read by status.depmap and profile.fit (session tools) only; run by tests 42 and 47 (tests/test_depmap.py, tests/test_profile_jsimports.py, tests/test_profile_fit.py)

profile.kustomize.why: the paths a Kustomize kustomization file names (resources, components, patches, generators' files), read by status.depmap (a session tool) only; run by tests 42 and 47 (tests/test_depmap.py, tests/test_profile_kustomize.py)

profile.nx.why: an Nx project's lint and test targets as the commands their executors run, read by profile.fit (a session tool) only; run by a session and by test 47 (tests/test_profile_nx.py)

profile.pypath.why: the directories a Python file puts on sys.path, read statically, read by status.depmap (a session tool) only; run by tests 42 and 47 (tests/test_depmap.py, tests/test_profile_pypath.py)

profile.yamlblock.why: a reader of the YAML of CI and container files (block and flow collections, scalars, anchors and merge keys), used by profile.ghactions for status.depmap (a session tool) only; run by tests 42 and 47 (tests/test_depmap.py, tests/test_profile_yamlblock.py)

status.depmap.why: the dependency drawings, run in a session and by test 42; the loop never runs it

status.exit_b.why: the exit audit of asama-0/10a against harness.pass_row and the generated docs/exit-b.md, run by a session (python tests/test_rehearsal.py --doc) and by test 45 (tests/test_exit_b.py, tests/test_rehearsal.py); the loop never runs it
